$comment: Irreversible endpoint classification (CAT-08). A catalog entry is irreversible when its method and path (inventory form, ':param' segments) match a rule. The reason is shown in confirmation previews. First match wins. Every DELETE is irreversible. Reviewed by the safety-reviewer before merge; changing a rule is a security-relevant change.

rules.reason: Deletes data; it cannot be restored from the API.
May send an initial outbound message the customer receives when `message` is provided.
Sends a message the customer receives (unless private: true); it cannot be unsent.
Sends or re-sends a message, payment order, or meeting link the customer sees.
Schedules a WhatsApp message the customer will receive.
Sends WhatsApp messages to customers; Meta bills for them and they cannot be recalled.
Creates or updates a campaign; when save_mode is send_now/schedule it schedules or sends messages Meta bills for.
Creates campaigns or changes a campaign audience in bulk.
Sends an email to the recipient.
Places or answers a WhatsApp call the customer sees.
Sends a call-permission request to the customer.
Merges two contacts; the merge cannot be undone.
Changes many records at once.
Executes a macro across conversations; may send messages or change state in bulk.
Changes many help-center articles at once.
Deletes all notifications.
Deletes custom attribute values.
Imports records into the account in bulk.
Closes the deal as won; may send a Meta Conversions API Purchase event.
Closes the deal as lost.
Moving a deal to a won or lost stage triggers closing side effects and Meta Conversions API events.
Re-sends a conversion event to Meta.
Changes which conversion events are sent to Meta.
Creates, edits or appeals a WhatsApp template at Meta (review and quality effects).
Creates a CSAT WhatsApp template at Meta (submitted for review).
Changes a WhatsApp Flow at Meta; publishing and deprecation are one-way.
Changes the Meta Business Agent configuration at Meta; customers may be answered differently.
Changes the Meta Business Agent at Meta or hands conversations over; customers may be answered differently.
Changes who answers the customer (Meta Business Agent vs. humans).
Changes which bot or AI agent answers customers live.
Pauses or resumes a paid Meta Ads campaign.
Triggers a verification code or changes the phone number identity at Meta.
Changes Meta Commerce catalog or product links visible to customers.
Provisions a paid virtual phone number or registers it with Meta.
Rotates credentials or backup codes, changes SSO, or configures outbound event webhooks.
Changes WhatsApp calling settings for the number at Meta.
